rv.q: As of No. 9,980, there's still life in the modestly diverting thriller.
Perfect Crime is a charmless, clueless play that passed its sell-by date 20 years ago.
Perfect Crime is still an intriguing thriller full of unexpected twists and turns.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this long-running mystery thriller: some find it an intriguing whodunit with unexpected twists, while others criticize awkward dialogue and lack of polish, questioning whether it lives up to its remarkable longevity.
